en.quote: …on taxes, we discussed the issue last year [in 2024] and agreed that, as a baseline, we would leave taxes unchanged.
en.head: VAT at 22%
en.body: On November 28, 2025, Putin signed a law raising VAT from 20% to 22% from January 1, 2026. According to the Federal Tax Service, the increase brought 426 billion rubles to the budget in the first half of 2026.
en.meta_context: St. Petersburg International Economic Forum, Sberbank breakfast

notes: Keep “as a baseline” to reflect базово rather than an unconditional pledge.
